observations: Multiple stacks of used car tyres piled outdoors.
Tyres show significant tread wear and dirt, consistent with being used.
A red marking is visible on the sidewall of one tyre in the center stack.
A watermark 'POSTED ON JIJI EMANUEL EKE' is present on the image.
No brand logos, model numbers, or sidewall markings are legible in the photo.

claims.evidence: Photo 0 shows only tyres; no rims are visible.
Tyres are a type of spare part, but the seller's claim is generic.

claims.claim: Tread is still 90 percent, no patch, no bulge. Removed from a 2023 car.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: Tyres may be old stock (expired) or have hidden damage.
risks.proof: A photo of the 4-digit DOT code on the sidewall.

risks.risk: Rims may be missing or damaged.
risks.proof: A photo of the rims alongside the tyres.

risks.risk: Tyres may have hidden punctures or internal damage.
risks.proof: A video showing a hand-puncture test or a visual inspection of the tread.

proof_requests: Photo of the 4-digit DOT code on the sidewall of a tyre.
Photo of the rims alongside the tyres.
Photo of the tyre size markings (e.g., 205/55R16) on the sidewall.
Photo of the tyre tread depth with a depth gauge.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
